narrative: Qualcomm's June 24 Dragonfly roadmap attaches Meta as the first named hyperscaler backing a merchant non-Nvidia stack, pairing the C1000 CPU and AI300 inference accelerator against Nvidia's inference economics. Once one operator is on record, the inference-cost argument becomes a peer-validated procurement signal rivals must answer, the competitive force this thesis expects to pull in a second name.
remaining_gap: No second top-tier hyperscaler has gone on record, and Qualcomm's first commercial sampling is still two years out in 2028.
